title: Volume-dependent geometry and symmetry transitions of torsion optimizers in infinite cylinders
summary: We study relative torsional rigidity in infinite cylinders, addressing two geometric questions raised by Caldiroli, Iacopetti and Pacella on the shape of volume-constrained optimizers. The torsion problem has Dirichlet conditions on the free boundary and Neumann conditions on the fixed lateral wall. At small volumes we establish a two-term expansion of the optimal energy, curvature selection, and quantitative convergence of optimizers to boundary half-balls.
